animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose and end in the exact supplied crouching lunging punch pose. Animate ONE SINGLE continuous crouching lunging punch spread evenly across the clip (never a second punch or preliminary jab), pure body motion only in empty air: staying low on the baseline without standing up, she first performs one smooth wind-up coil drawing her punching shoulder and fist back while loading her legs; then she lunges forward and extends her punching arm steadily inch by inch through many intermediate angles into full horizontal reach, arriving cleanly on the exact supplied final pose on the last frame.
